title: RBI Monetary Penalty on IndusInd Bank Limited
description: <cite index="26-1">The RBI imposed a monetary penalty of ₹59.20 lakh on IndusInd Bank Limited for non-compliance with certain provisions of directions issued by RBI on 'Interest Rate on Deposits' and 'Securitisation of Standard Assets'</cite>. The penalty was based on supervisory findings from the bank's financial position as of March 31, 2025.
